purpose: Evolve causal DEFENSIVE exposure ceilings while preserving the frozen trade mechanism and allocator priority.
frozen_allocator_priority: lower stock realized-volatility percentile ranks first among simultaneous qualifying signals

exposure_genome.form: small causal decision tree mapping market-state percentiles to permitted slots
exposure_genome.normalization: development-only; LOEO fold excludes held-out episode

execution.when_exposure_ceiling_falls: do not force-liquidate existing positions; prohibit new entries until live positions are below ceiling
execution.ranking_when_capacity_scarce: frozen lower stock realized-volatility percentile first; ticker alphabetical final tie-break

fitness.inactivity_penalty: 0.05 if fewer than 3 episodes contain trades

hard_rules: No future information in exposure state.
A/B/C, recovery and R-1 definitions cannot mutate.
No TEST17, preserved50, remaining Discovery, Verification A or Verification B.
